source: probe-best-v2.json, band 1 only — the plan that scored 0.9344 on the validation API (20 Sep 01:45 UTC)
bbox: normalised [x0,y0,x1,y1] against 3840x2160, clipped to the frame
caveats: Not organiser truth, but every class here has been measured on its own single-class attempt, so the per_class_ap above says exactly how far each one can be trusted.

large_tower and large_launcher boxes are hand-drawn by Oscar and fitted per instance in width, height and centre; they are NOT the tracker output and are much better than it (0.943 vs 0.762, 0.927 vs 0.823). Scoring a tracker change against them is not circular.
medium_launcher at 0.777 is the weakest class. It has three launchers, not two: the extra one is a spiky launcher beside the lattice tower at frames 92-124, ground (-70.5,-8600).
The organiser box is LARGER than the visible silhouette, by roughly 1.3x wide and 1.45x tall on medium_launcher, and by at least 1.6x on small_launcher. Do not tighten these boxes.
Edge frames are included: any frame with a visible sliver counts, and at a bottom exit the truth box is the visible strip, not the projected footprint.
The jet_plane track over frames 40-52 has been removed; it was forest canopy, not an aircraft.
